project-1: Ismir Etiket - Started operations in 2009 and still holds a special place in customers' hearts. The business specializes in producing high-quality products.
project-1-problem: The initial website was single-language, slow to load, and had a non-intuitive UI, making it difficult for users.
project-1-solve: To improve performance and usability, I used Vite for speed, Tailwind CSS for a clean UI, and i18next for multilingual support with easy language switching.
project-1-result: The site became faster, more user-friendly, and accessible in multiple languages, providing a better brand experience.
project-2: Mega Coffee Order App - A web application for ordering coffee. Provides a convenient interface to select drinks and place orders online.
project-2-problem: The coffee order design was not intuitive, making it inconvenient for users.
project-2-solve: Used Axios, Vite, and Tailwind CSS to implement fast performance and a simple, clean UI for easier ordering.
project-2-result: Created a minimal and intuitive order app, making it easy and convenient for users.
project-3: Cool Pic - A modern web app for sharing and discovering photos. Users can upload and explore images shared by others.
project-3-solve: Solved this by implementing Cloudinary, CORS, JWT, Mongoose, and bcrypt for secure and stable image uploads.
project-3-result: The result was a complete MERN project with a clear and well-structured database.
project-4: Movie Seats - An online movie seat reservation platform for booking cinema tickets.
project-4-problem: API (PUT) requests caused issues in the seat reservation process, making booking unreliable.
project-4-solve: Implemented a secure seat reservation system using Axios, MongoDB, and JWT to handle booking properly.
project-4-result: Duplicate reservations were prevented, ensuring two users could not book the same seat.
